description.short: Mountain bike and e-bike skills coaching, guided rides and trail management courses in the Afan Valley, South Wales. Delivered by accredited coaches Ally and Bob Campbell with 20+ years of MTB-specific experience.
description.full: Campbell Coaching is a specialist mountain bike and e-bike coaching, guiding, and trail management business based in Afan, South Wales. Founded by accredited coaches Ally and Bob Campbell, the business draws on over 20 years of MTB-focused coaching experience to deliver progressive, tailored sessions for riders of all abilities. Coaching takes place at their own private skills venue in the Afan Valley and on the forest trails of Afan Forest Park — some of the most celebrated singletrack terrain in South Wales. The business also runs sessions at One Giant Leap, Llangollen in North Wales. Campbell Coaching is noted for small group ratios and use of video analysis to accelerate rider development. Alongside rider coaching, the business delivers professional Association of Trail Builders (ATB) trail management and inspection courses for land managers and bike park operators. Ally Campbell was named in Cycling UK's '100 Women in Cycling 2021' and co-organises the Sisters of Send women's MTB festival.
